title: the depth proof's admissions are entered in the exemption set
intention: Every single-file admission in cairn/tools/import_sieve/proofs/test_an_admission_holds_at_any_depth.py's rule literals is entered in the exemption set at that seat or stands under fixtures/, so the sole_path_admissions_are_entered sieve reads the live repo clean.
why: Measured 2026-11-10: cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_an_unentered_admission_reds.py tooth test_the_live_repo_reads_clean reds with four findings, all seated at cairn/tools/import_sieve/proofs/test_an_admission_holds_at_any_depth.py: bus_client/remote.py, bus_client/tls.py, bus/proofs/test_the_bus_speaks_tcp.py and bus/proofs/test_x.py are single-file admissions with no exemption entry. The tester raised trouble seal-red-cairn-machines-build-inspector-proofs-test-an-unentered-admission-reds.
traces_to: Outline 9.4.6 (exemptions: the declared list of places a check skips something, each with its reason; WHY: a skip with no written reason is a hole nobody can see); Law 9 (a deterministic red is fixed, never explained).
how: Enter the inference rule's three file admissions (bus_client/remote.py, bus_client/tls.py, bus/proofs/test_the_bus_speaks_tcp.py) at the seat cairn/tools/import_sieve/proofs/test_an_admission_holds_at_any_depth.py, with the kind and evidence their siblings carry at cairn/tools/import_sieve/proofs/test_import_sieve.py; move tooth 1's synthetic world (it admits bus/proofs/test_x.py, a path no file holds) to cairn/tools/import_sieve/proofs/fixtures/a_file_admitted_at_depth.py, the berth the sieve declares out of reach for fixture rules. Red-first proof in exemptions.

clauses.claim: inspect(component='exemptions') returns no finding whose method is sole_path_admissions_are_entered

for each of bus_client/remote.py, bus_client/tls.py and bus/proofs/test_the_bus_speaks_tcp.py an entry stands at path cairn/tools/import_sieve/proofs/test_an_admission_holds_at_any_depth.py whose symbol names that member, whose kind is sieve-scope, and whose justification_kind and evidence equal those of the entry at cairn/tools/import_sieve/proofs/test_import_sieve.py for the same file

exactly three entries stand at path cairn/tools/import_sieve/proofs/test_an_admission_holds_at_any_depth.py, so the synthetic admission bus/proofs/test_x.py is out of the sieve's reach rather than entered
